> [!PREVIEW]
> `backdown unmount` isn't in v0.2.0-alpha.4, the current download: it comes with the next preview.


```text
backdown unmount [OPTIONS] <TARGET>
```

## Arguments

`<TARGET>`
: The partition or disk image, as `backdown mount` lists it.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

Only what `backdown mount` (or the browser's Mount read-only) mounted; detaching an image unmounts everything mounted from it.

## Examples

```sh
backdown unmount /dev/sdb1
backdown unmount /media/archive/Images/old-laptop.img
```
